limits: One run of development cases; no repeated-run uncertainty or hidden-deployment claim.
Offline and routed run sequentially; operating-system file caches are not cleared.
Missing, failed and model-skipped cases remain in the 70-case accuracy denominator.
Routed scores include fallback predictions; adoption is reported separately.
Costs use competition rates and conservative unknown-request reservations, not billing records.
Four batches reset circuit state; this development experiment is not the official 20-case resource test.

offline.note: Reported per-case wall clock; rounded to milliseconds by the runner.

routed.note: Reported per-case wall clock; rounded to milliseconds by the runner.

offline.scope: Coverage and schema only; not verification of every evidence claim.

routed.scope: Coverage and schema only; not verification of every evidence claim.

definitions.attempt: One durable request-attempt audit; unknown outcomes do not prove that the provider accepted/billed it.
definitions.json_parsed_ok: Transport event status=ok; distinct from Controller validation.
definitions.verified_answer: Controller decision status=verified, resolved to its actual successful attempt model.
definitions.final_adopted: Unique adopted Controller decision plus model mode; requested routing model is not used as source attribution.
definitions.reconstructed_rejection: Later repair feedback matched to an earlier response when a hard-timeout checkpoint lost Controller decisions.
definitions.unknown_reserved_dollars: Conservative reservations, not verified billing; retained after local cancellation.
definitions.score: Existing official scorer applied offline to completed predictions only; partial/strict do not verify evidence truth.
definitions.heuristic_comparator: Same trace heuristic_prediction, with completed offline batch fallback if absent.

limits: One run per case, without repeated-run or unseen-deployment evidence.
Unknown request durations are absent rather than zero; audited request seconds are incomplete.
Recovered checkpoints can lose in-memory decision events; raw JSON action alone is not structural acceptance.
Original development labels were used only for offline scoring, never to modify retrieval or prompts; no retrieval-experiment label files were read.
Model IDs used here are actual audit models; same-case score changes alone do not establish a general causal model benefit.

interpretation_and_limits: This is the original retrieval baseline after hard-deadline repair, not the retrieval_v2 candidate.
Both modes completed70/70 with nonempty outputs and passed the saved-output contract audit.
Routed degraded development-set accuracy: strict6/70 versus10/70; partial0.188 versus0.2522857143.
Every routed case attempted a model call, but only46/70 adopted a verified model answer;24 used fallback.
No case exceeded55seconds;14 cases required the outer hard-deadline fallback. Deadline compliance is not diagnosis success.
Known-usage price estimates and unknown-request reservations are separate; neither is an audited account bill.
The $0.99 budget and costs refer to this70-case run, excluding preceding smoke/probe experiments.
One sequential development run with four batches; no repeated-run uncertainty, unseen-deployment or Docker2CPU/8GB certification.
Model-specific adoption counts concern routed case mixes, not a randomized same-case head-to-head comparison.
Full-suite comparison uses the separately run offline baseline:14 changed outputs,1 improved,6 worsened.
Diagnostics also compare against each online trace own heuristic:16 changed outputs,2 improved,7 equal,7 worsened; these are distinct comparators.
Full-suite process time includes child-process launch overhead; diagnostic batch_process_seconds sums inner CLI durations.
Validation of the separate retrieval candidate is not included in this artifact.
privacy: No ground-truth labels, prediction strings, prompts, provider response bodies, API credentials or absolute workspace paths are included.
